image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a white transparent audio cassette tape resting on a wooden surface. The cassette is the primary subject, positioned diagonally. It features two visible spools inside the clear plastic casing, an orange write-protection tab, and printed text/graphics on the label area. The background is a blurred wooden texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small rectangular plastic enclosure fitting comfortably in palm with thickness much smaller than width or height.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object clearly exhibits the proportions of a standard cassette: a flat, rectangular prism where width > height > thickness. The scale relative to the wood grain suggests it is handheld size.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flat rectangular prism with rounded corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The overall shape is a rectangle with distinctly rounded corners, matching the physical design of a cassette shell.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two circular holes revealing tape spools inside.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct circular apertures are visible on the face of the cassette, through which internal structures (spools) can be seen.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two spools of magnetic tape visible through circular holes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Inside the circular holes, gear-like structures consistent with tape spools are visible. They appear structurally sound and correctly placed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular opening at bottom exposing tape for player head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A wide rectangular slot is present along the bottom edge of the cassette face, typical for exposing the magnetic tape to the player head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface has molded details screw holes tape guide slots and write-protect tabs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: An orange rectangular tab (write-protect) is clearly visible near the top right. Small indentations and structural ribs consistent with molding details are visible on the plastic surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Casing transparent or opaque plastic typically black gray or clear.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The casing is made of translucent/transparent white plastic, allowing visibility of internal components, which fits the 'transparent or opaque' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label area on one face displaying track information artist and title.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a printed label area with black text and graphics. While the specific text is blurry/unreadable due to resolution/depth of field, the presence of a label with simulated text is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Visible internal spools through transparent casing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The transparency of the plastic allows the internal spool mechanisms to be seen, confirming this material property.

artifact_observations.location: Label area on the cassette face
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the label is illegible and appears as generic scribbles or pseudo-text rather than crisp, readable characters. This is common in AI generation but represents a minor fidelity issue for a real-world object that usually has clear printing.

The specular highlights on the plastic are somewhat soft and diffuse, lacking the sharp, crisp reflections typical of hard plastic. The edges show slight blurring into the background, suggesting minor boundary ambiguity.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a cassette and not a similar rectangular plastic object (e.g., VHS adapter, game case).
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text on the label, checking for severe gibberish or character fusion artifacts.
To verify the physical continuity of the plastic shell and ensure the 'holes' are actual voids and not painted circles, and to check for edge bleeding.
To assess the realism of the plastic material properties (refraction/reflection) and the depth of field blur.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of label text
Structural integrity of the spools inside the circular holes
Realism of plastic transparency and refraction
Sharpness of the rectangular bottom slot
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the label; AI often fails to render coherent text on small objects. Verify if the internal spools have a logical mechanical structure (gears/teeth) or if they look like melted blobs. Check if the 'transparency' of the plastic looks physically accurate or just like a semi-transparent overlay.
